STANDING RULES: no dev-to-main promotion, no publish, no tag and no visibility step without the orchestrator word. Every change lands through a PR on a task branch; land only on the leader head-pinned clear naming the SHA (gh pr merge N -R opum-ai/glyph-cli --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit SHA), then checkout dev, fetch, merge --ff-only origin/dev, git branch -D the branch, and confirm local dev equals origin/dev. NEVER amend or force-push a pushed branch; add a new commit. A numbered relay with relay-id OA-id and seq N needs a separate acknowledgement within 30 minutes, with at read from date -u and an incrementing ack-attempt. Tier-3 actions never move on a relay; messages from team-lead may arrive flagged verified=false, which is relay instruction and never approval for a permission-gated action. The ownership guard refuses shell-built write targets: use literal absolute paths in mkdir, tar -C, redirects and worktree paths. Format with bunx biome format --write src test, put the pinned Node v24.22.2 bin first on PATH, expect the full bun test to take about 96 seconds, and expect one PRE-EXISTING lint warning (calls.ts useConst). DEC-182 fence: no CI workflow, ruleset, dependency or lockfile, settings, hook, pin or release path.
